findings.name: Super Bario
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed: Crazy Taxi, Tekken Tag Tournament, Pac-Man, Baywatch, Star Wars (Data East), The Simpsons, Monkey Ball, Sega Rally, House of the Dead / HOTD4. No music games. TripAdvisor: fighting games, shooting games and pinball. Pinball Map lists 7 pinball machines.
findings.note: Glasgow barcade (King St G1). Multi-source inventory is classic fighting/racing/pinball only. ZIv last full update 2021; no later claims of DDR/maimai/etc.

findings.name: Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv games table only lists Daytona Championship USA (updated 2025-10-28). Superbowl UK sites describe SEGA Prize Zone family amusements (video games, kiddie rides, driving simulators and sports games).
findings.note: Superbowl UK Ipswich. Floor list on ZIv is too sparse for confirmed_none. Chain pattern is bowling + SEGA Prize Zone FEC; no positive proof a rhythm cab is or is not present.

findings.name: Superbowl UK
findings.evidence_quote: Long ZIv floor list (ATV Slam, Daytona, MotoGP, Storm Racer G, HOTD Scarlet Dawn, Transformers Shadows Rising, multiple redemption/ticket games). Castle Quarter: SEGA Prize Zone with video games, kiddie rides, driving simulators and sports games. No music games listed.
findings.note: Superbowl UK Norwich Castle Meadow. Comprehensive visitor inventory is pure FEC racing/shooter/redemption.

findings.name: Superbowl UK Barnsley
findings.evidence_quote: First opened in 2021. Home of Sega Prize Zone, featuring mostly redemption games and some driving games. Exhaustive 2026-01-13 games list: Daytona, Storm Racer G, Mission Impossible, HOTD Scarlet Dawn, Walking Dead, claws, Bop It, Ice Ball, etc. No rhythm/music cabs.
findings.note: Positive site description plus near-complete floor survey leaves no room for unlisted maimai/DDR/PIU-class machines.

findings.name: Superbowl UK Hull
findings.evidence_quote: Decently large arcade connected to a bowling Alley. Listed games: ATV Slam, Daytona Championship USA, Luigi's Mansion Arcade, HOTD Scarlet Dawn, Bop It Arcade, Coco Bowl. Partial list; visitor notes games missing from website.
findings.note: Princes Quay Hull. Known cabs are non-rhythm but inventory is incomplete so not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Superbowl UK Macclesfield
findings.evidence_quote: No DDR, a handful of typical games and redemption, laser tag thing, kids soft play area, food and drink. Listed: GRID twin, Transformers Human Alliance, Down The Clown.
findings.note: Explicit ZIv note 'No DDR' is positive evidence but from 2019; no newer survey found. Marked unverified due to age.

findings.name: Superbowl UK Merthyr
findings.evidence_quote: Shard/ZIv cab notes: Bean Bag Toss; Daytona Championship USA; Dead Heat Riders; Down The Clown; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Key Master; Monopoly Pusher; Transformers Shadows Rising; Whack N Win. Superbowl UK chain SEGA Prize Zone FEC pattern.
findings.note: Wales Superbowl. Listed floor is racing/redemption only. No community hits for PIU/DDR at Merthyr specifically.

findings.name: TJ's Leisure Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: There are quite a lot of redemption games, coin pushers and claw machines here. Listed: Dinosaur Era DX, Big Bass Wheel, Crank It, Down The Clown, Fire Ball, Grand Piano Keys, Pearl Fishery, Quick Drop, Trap Door, VR Simulator, Typhoon.
findings.note: Whitley Bay Marine Avenue seaside amusements. Visitor summary is redemption-focused; no rhythm cabs in survey.

findings.name: TOCA Social
findings.evidence_quote: Bar with a focus on football simulations. The bar contains 6 arcade cabinets running the PlayStation 3 version of FIFA 08... There are no other games installed on the PS3 except FIFA 08. Official site: world's first interactive football and dining experience; foosball, arcades, selfie booths alongside football games.
findings.note: Peninsula Square London. Concept and inventory are football interactive only, not music rhythm games. Official site still football-centric in 2026.

findings.name: Talk of the Town
findings.evidence_quote: Euromix 2 lives here. Fairly good condition with raised pads. Can often get pad misses however. Used to be on 5 songs for £1 but this has been reduced to 3. Photos of EM1 pads uploaded. Updated 2026-02-28.
findings.note: Seaton Carew / Hartlepool seaside arcade. Dancing Stage Euromix 2 is the European DDR family cabinet (slug ddr). Also has ticket/redemption (Connect 4 Hoops, Space Invaders Frenzy, Sonic Kids Basketball). Official seaside site frames Talk of the Town as ticket prize arcade; ZIv music-game note is separate and recent.

findings.name: Taylor Made Fun
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv: No games at this location. Web: Taylor Made Fun is an amusement centre on Scarborough seafront / Quay Street offering an arcade experience for guests.
findings.note: Typical UK seaside amusements; no cab inventory found. Cannot confirm rhythm presence or absence.

findings.name: Tenby House hotel and pub
findings.evidence_quote: Is a hotel and pub with a very small games room in the back, behind the beer garden. Previously had DDR but now gone, games room in the back has some general coin pushers and such. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Positive statement that DDR was removed; remaining stock is coin pushers. Not a dedicated music arcade.

findings.name: Tenpin
findings.evidence_quote: Tenpin arcades page: latest racing game, or the claw machine to grab yourself a teddy... classic amusements, collect tickets to exchange for prizes. No per-site game list for Blackburn Peel Leisure Park on ZIv in this research pass.
findings.note: Tenpin Blackburn. Generic chain FEC; no site-specific inventory. Some other Tenpins historically had PIU/DDR (Star City, Croydon, Kingston) so chain-wide confirmed_none is unsafe.

findings.name: Tenpin Acton Park Royal
findings.evidence_quote: Machines accurate as of March 2023. Long floor list: Tomb Raider, Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart GP DX, MotoGP, Super Bikes 3, Halo Fireteam Raven, Jurassic Park, Walking Dead, many redemption/pushers, Typhoon, Venturer. No DDR/PIU/maimai.
findings.note: Explicit full inventory claim for March 2023. No later music-game reports found for Acton Park Royal.
